records.closureSearchResult: Current municipal permit route is explicit: Vergunningcheck first; if still uncertain, information request with clear plan description and sketches of existing/new situation including all dimensions and all structures on the plot; formal application through Omgevingsloket. Regular statutory period is 8 weeks plus possible 6-week extension; municipality aims at 4 weeks for compliant applications. If the plan conflicts with the Omgevingsplan, a principle request can be filed.

records.closureSearchResult: Current permit/product layer is now clear: Vergunningcheck and application via Omgevingsloket; free concept request; participation information in application; regular procedure usually max 8 weeks and extensive procedure up to 6 months; current 2026 Legesverordening is in force. Fire-safety use notification/permit route is also current. A concept Huisvestingsverordening 2026, including measures such as opkoopbescherming, was placed for consultation in March-April 2026, but current public municipal material still describes it as concept and a definitive adopted version was not positively established in this closure search. Therefore the concept is not encoded as current law.

Fresh official-source review materially improves the splitting side. The current house-number product explicitly states that a dwelling split requires an omgevingsvergunning or woonsplitsingsvergunning and that the house-number request is handled with that permit; it also lists floor plan and site drawing for BAG numbering. For plans that conflict with the Omgevingsplan, the municipality directs smaller plans to an omgevingsvergunning for contrary use and larger plans to an Omgevingsplan change/principle-request route via ODGM. Historic municipal material shows that the inner-city regime previously allowed broader non-household occupancy and was targeted for restriction, but this older preparatory decision is not treated as proof of the current 2026 substantive room-rental rule.

qualityRule: Draft or historic housing instruments are never encoded as current law without positive current-status confirmation. A practical permit route can be closed separately from an unresolved substantive municipal housing rule.
